about_the_game:
Immerse yourself even deeper into the world of Forgotten Fragments.

This official soundtrack features 10 original tracks, composed exclusively for the game. Each piece has been carefully crafted to capture the atmosphere of Enid, Ryder, and Dayen’s journey. From mysterious puzzles to epic boss battles.

Atmospheric, captivating, and memorable, the soundtrack lets you relive your adventure any time you like. Perfect for fans of melodic game music, pixel-art worlds, and enchanting soundscapes.

Includes:

🎵 10 original tracks
🎵 MP3 + high-quality formats (where supported)
🎵 Music designed to accompany both the solo and co-op campaigns
